title: COMPONENT_NAME doc's `ext:` justification is unsupported by any descriptor this code reads
reason: Refuted by the real input: spring-projects/spring-boot's checked-out antora.yml stub at v3.3.0/v3.4.0/v3.5.0/v3.5.16 is 'name: boot / version: true / ext: / zip_contents_collector: / include: / - name: root / - name: api', so indented name: keys under ext: are the only shape componentNameOf ever parses. upstream-antora.md:77 names zip_contents_collector too.

title: Gate re-resolves upstream instead of reading the already-resolved object
reason: by design: requiredArtifactUrls IS the single-sourcing mechanism the cited convention describes, and its (project, version) signature is required by detect-upstream-versions.ts which holds no UpstreamCoordinates; resolveUpstream is pure over PROJECTS + two string args so divergence is provably impossible

title: partitionByPublication's missing-URL-to-version mapping is untested
reason: refuted: the cited mapping is a Set union so both named failure modes are impossible; the probes array and the classification loop are byte-identical to origin/main, and the half the diff actually altered (the concurrency pool) moved to scripts/lib/artifact-availability.ts with 12 new tests

title: fetch-upstream.ts Code Map / Entry Points rows omit the new pre-clone publication gate
reason: by design: no Entry Points row and no pipeline-script Code Map row enumerates a failure mode; detect-upstream-versions.ts's row has never mentioned its own pre-existing publication gate and is untouched here. Both fetch-upstream.ts rows also remain factually accurate
